title: # System Health
footer: > Silence longer than 2 days = red flag. This block belongs in every morning briefing.
commits_paused: {n} commits (push deliberately paused, no_push flag set)
llm_no_record: no record yet (waiting for an automation LLM call)
llm_auth: authentication error ({ago}): {detail}. Log in again with 'claude'
llm_auth_worker: authentication error ({ago}): {detail}. Log in again with 'claude' on {worker}
crm_auth: API token rejected ({ago}): {detail}. Refresh the token file
worker_no_trace: no {worker} trace in the last 100 commits
morning_ok: today's file exists and carries the health block
morning_no_block: today's file exists but has no health block (the morning set may not have run)
morning_missing: not produced today (morning set, tools/morning_briefing.py, first hourly run after 07:00 on weekdays); see logs/morning.log
kill_ok: no breach, {due} due within {days} days, {missing} projects without criteria
privacy_exposed: NOT ignored: {paths}. A rename broke a .gitignore rule; fix before the next commit
pile_detail: {inbox} files; the belief's criterion is near zero. Analyses per decision {qpd}, orphan pages {orphans}, counted {date}
vault_graph_stale: report {age}; the nightly vault-graph step is not running
vault_graph_leaks: {leaks} tracked file(s) link to gitignored paths; inspect .wiki/_vault-graph-report.md
lint_detail: broken links {broken}, orphans {orphans}, stale summaries {stale}, frontmatter {fm} (report {age})
lint_stale: report {age}; the nightly lint step is not running, read logs/lint.log
runs_ok: {jobs} jobs, none failed, quiet or dry
runs_partial: {job} finished only partly last run ({day} {time}); read its log
runs_contradictions_skipped: {job}: contradiction check skipped (search addon missing in this Python)
runs_dry: {job} {field}=0 for {days} days, capture path may be broken
runs_retrieval: retrieval fell to hit@5 {now}% (best {best}% this fortnight), see tools/retrieval_eval.py
backup_detail: last archive {made} days ago, last restore test: {verified} days ago
api_budget_no_record: no spend recorded yet this period
api_budget_warn: {spent} of {budget} USD ({pct}%) since {start}: past the warning ratio
api_budget_stop: {spent} of {budget} USD ({pct}%) since {start}: API lanes run on the fallback until the reset day
routing_ok: {count} local-only lanes, all on a local provider
routing_no_config: brainless.toml missing; local lanes now run on the cloud default
routing_empty: brainless.toml has no llm.local_only list; nothing is pinned local
routing_unknown: local_only names unknown lanes: {lanes}. A typo leaves the real lane unpinned
routing_drift: local-only lanes on a cloud provider: {lanes}. llm.py refuses them; fix brainless.toml or the env override
wiki_privacy_debt: {n} files, baseline {base} ({kinds}); known debt, fix at ingest (P0.2)
wiki_privacy_new: {n} files, baseline {base} ({kinds}); a NEW leak in the compiled layer
wiki_privacy_held: ; last gate {date} held {n} files back from the commit
cloud_exclude_ok: {count} folder(s) present, no egress from them in 24 hours
cloud_exclude_empty: no cloud_exclude list in PROFILE.md; no folder is kept off the cloud
cloud_exclude_missing: listed folder(s) no longer on disk: {paths}. A rename kills the rule silently
cloud_exclude_egress: a cloud call in the last 24 hours was built from a cloud-excluded source (lane: {lanes})
cloud_exclude_refused: {n} blocked call(s) refused in the last 24 hours; nothing was sent
